steps.code:
Portainer → Stacks → + Add stack
  Name:          endgame
  Build method:  Web editor
  Web editor:    paste the whole of docker-compose.prod.yml
steps.note: The name matters: Dock finds its neighbours as endgame-edge-1 and so on. Another name needs ENDGAME_STACK_NAME set to match. Not yet run with real credentials (ARCH-008): what you will see, not a recorded run.

steps.code:
# REQUIRED — the stack refuses to start without every one of these seven.
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=
ENDGAME_SERVICE_TOKEN=
DOCK_SECRET_KEY=
OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
ENDGAME_VAULT_MASTER_KEY=
ENDGAME_OPERATORS=
ENDGAME_BACKUP_KEY=

# WHERE IT LIVES — defaults shown; set only what differs.
ENDGAME_STACK_NAME=endgame
ENDGAME_GATEWAY_PORT=8095
ENDGAME_CONSOLE_HOST=endgame.frostaura.net
ENDGAME_ZONE=frostaura.net
ENDGAME_IMAGE_TAG=latest
ENDGAME_IMAGE_NAMESPACE=frostaura
DOCKER_SOCKET_GID=0

# THE TUNNEL — pick one.
COMPOSE_PROFILES=
CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN=

# OUTGOING MAIL — optional.
SMTP_HOST=
SMTP_PORT=587
SMTP_USERNAME=
SMTP_PASSWORD=
SMTP_FROM=
SMTP_STARTTLS=true

# OFFSITE BACKUPS — optional, all four or none.
ENDGAME_BACKUP_S3_ENDPOINT=
ENDGAME_BACKUP_S3_BUCKET=
ENDGAME_BACKUP_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=
ENDGAME_BACKUP_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=
ENDGAME_BACKUP_S3_REGION=auto
ENDGAME_BACKUP_DIR=
BACKUP_HOUR_UTC=1
ENDGAME_BACKUP_KEEP_DAILY=7
ENDGAME_BACKUP_KEEP_WEEKLY=4
ENDGAME_BACKUP_SCHEDULE=true

# CLOUDFLARE MANAGEMENT — optional, and held.
CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=
CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=
CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID=
CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_ID=

# TUNING — optional.
DOCK_APP_MEMORY_BUDGET_MB=4096
DOCK_SUBNET_POOL=10.213.0.0/16
ENDGAME_USAGE_REPORT_SECONDS=300
POSTGRES_USER=endgame
POSTGRES_DB=endgame
steps.note: Environment variables → Advanced mode → paste this, from .env.production.example (its comments shortened), and fill it in. Each required key: openssl rand -hex 32 (24 for the password). Keep DOCK_SECRET_KEY, ENDGAME_VAULT_MASTER_KEY and ENDGAME_BACKUP_KEY off this machine too.

Deploy the stack, and within about a minute every service reports healthy. The edge is the only published port, and its /health names the commit it was built from. Not yet run with real credentials (ARCH-008): what you will see, not a recorded run.

steps.code:
(a) a tunnel already on the host:
      endgame.<zone>  →  http://localhost:8095
      *.<zone>        →  http://localhost:8095
(b) the tunnel inside this stack:
      COMPOSE_PROFILES=tunnel
      CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN=<the tunnel's token>
      its public hostnames → http://edge:8080
steps.note: Pick one; with (b), update the stack after setting the two keys. The port is ENDGAME_GATEWAY_PORT. With the tunnel routed, https://endgame.<zone>/ opens the console. Not yet run with real credentials (ARCH-008): what you will see, not a recorded run.

steps.code:
https://endgame.<zone>/
  register a passkey with an address listed in ENDGAME_OPERATORS
  God mode → the organisation → top it up (OP-05)
steps.note: The operator's passkey is the first sign-in. Without SMTP nothing is e-mailed: codes and invitations are handed over by hand. Not yet run with real credentials (ARCH-008): what you will see, not a recorded run.

output: error while interpolating services.ops.environment.Ops__Backup__Key: required variable ENDGAME_BACKUP_KEY is missing a value: ENDGAME_BACKUP_KEY is required
steps.note: Portainer shows compose's error and the stack does not start. Each of the seven required keys has its own "X is required" message; which is reported first can vary. make prod-config (OPS-08) checks this one.
